effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] This Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ for the turn. (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.) Then, if a Digimon card with [Angoramon] in its name is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack.
